description: External works include replacement of existing non original rear doors to garden with timber framed door. Replacement of existing windows with double glazed timber windows and installation of 3x roof lights to the rear roof slope.Internal works include underpinning to existing structural walls with the installation of new insulated floor slab, cavity drainage membrane and sump at cellar floor level to form a utility and storage space. Opening up of existing fireplace to rear reception room; vaulting of existing kitchen ceiling and installation of new stairs down to converted cellar at ground floor level. Removal of built in cupboard/partition to existing bathroom, installation of staircase to new loft level, a hallway landing, partition wall to form smaller bedroom/lobby landing and installation of water cooling air conditioning system at first floor level. Conversion of existing loft space to form ensuite bedroom; installation of 3x roof lights and water cooling air conditioning system at attic floor level. (Asscoiated Full Planning Permission ref: 26/02837/FUL)
